duration.text: The Chinese language program at Guangdong University Of Foreign Studies is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2388 USD/per year ￥ 17200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Applicants must be eligible for student visa application and between the age of 18-35.2. Applicants must be law-abiding and adhere to the university regulations.3. Good physical and mental health. The tuition fee will not be refunded if the participant is unable to continue learning due to the sudden illness caused by concealing the health condition or fails to obtain the visa due to the personal reasons of the participant.4. Other requirements deemed necessary according to Chinese law and university regulations.
